route: shared operating contract, then focused change review

roles.name: quality-engineer
roles.reason: Assess correctness and verification of the complete pending change without remediation or scoring.

skills.name: change-review
skills.reason: The task explicitly requests review of staged, unstaged and relevant new files.

skills.name: structured-reflection
skills.reason: The shared operating contract calls for a bounded reflection after meaningful findings; record supported corrections without editing.

not_selected.test-engineering: No test suite authoring or test-strategy request; direct native reproductions suffice for these small arithmetic changes.
not_selected.security-review: No concrete security question in the changed arithmetic/formatting paths.

authority: Read-only workspace and instructions; only result.md, actions.md and selection.json written.
independence: Separate delegated review context; no author notes or previous verdict read. Parent conversation context was inherited, so full fresh-session isolation is not claimed.
